purpose: Define a reviewer-defensible benchmark surface without conflating external benchmarking with the F02 causal intervention estimands.

causal_firewall.rule: External comparators do not estimate H1, H2 or H3. They answer only comparative predictive/resource-performance questions.
causal_firewall.prohibited_claim: A favourable benchmark difference is not evidence that inherited state or inherited material caused the difference.

common_evaluation_semantics.stream_order: chronological and identical for every method within a scenario-realisation
common_evaluation_semantics.future_label_access: forbidden until the current prediction has been emitted and scored
common_evaluation_semantics.warmup: F07 must bind the exact pre-cut history/cut schedule to the F02 DEV design; F06 does not invent a new cut.
common_evaluation_semantics.primary_predictive_outcome: mean prequential 0-1 loss over the declared future horizon
common_evaluation_semantics.same_source_requirement: same immutable source bytes, scenario, realisation and horizon as the corresponding study cell
common_evaluation_semantics.seeds: predeclared, method-origin isolated and reused only as paired scenario-realisation scheduling keys, never copied from internal learner state

resource_fairness.internal_causal_arms: retain F02/F05 APW matching; do not alter it for benchmark convenience
resource_fairness.external_benchmarks: do not force artificial APW equality across fundamentally different algorithms; execute native algorithms under the same declared hardware/runtime policy and report their realised resource use
resource_fairness.decision_economics_use: F12 may use predictive loss versus measured resource/cost ratios, Pareto frontiers and break-even regions; it must not invent monetary costs.

legacy_firewall.rule: Preserve historical R06 evidence unchanged. Do not reuse its depth-8/majority-class profiles as the redesigned F06 reference baselines and do not relabel historical results as River 0.26.1.

failure_semantics.dependency_or_version_mismatch: ENVIRONMENT_INVALID; admit no scientific record; never substitute a different library/version/algorithm
failure_semantics.source_integrity_failure: INFRASTRUCTURE_INVALID; repair/version before rerun; never score as scientific loss
failure_semantics.unsupported_known_configuration_before_r: COMPARATOR_UNAVAILABLE; F07/F09 must resolve, remove prospectively with justification or block protocol freeze
failure_semantics.algorithm_failure_after_valid_admission: ALGORITHMIC_FAILURE; preserve the planned cell and failure point; F07/F09 must freeze whether post-failure slots are scored as operational loss or summarised through a joint loss-plus-failure estimand before CONF

ROLLING_CART window length and refit cadence
PLASTIC/PLASTIC-A/EFHAT runtime decision after official-runtime qualification
fully transitive hash-verified Python environment or container
JVM/MOA/CapyMOA build identity if PLASTIC is admitted
process isolation, thread policy and resource-sampling protocol
f09_gate: No CONF protocol may be frozen while any comparator marked required has an unresolved runtime, timing, resource or failure-semantics gate.
